response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his profile doesn't match this role's core requirement of deep, extensive C++ expertise (8 years) applied to large-scale cloud compute platforms. His career is centered on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web and infrastructure work, with only brief, early-career C++ exposure, and no evidence of leading cloud compute platform strategy or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers at the required scale.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience across many domains (web, mobile, embedded, distributed systems)
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and community-building (workshops, talks, open-source projects)
Solid experience with distributed, high-throughput systems (e.g., Sociomantic's microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (only ~1.5 years, a decade ago at National Instruments), far short of the 8-year requirement
No direct experience leading or architecting an internal cloud compute platform or hardware/storage architecture
Career trajectory shows broad generalist full-stack/web focus rather than deep specialization in large-scale cloud infrastructure leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform / infrastructure leadership experience
Strong general technical leadership and mentoring background
